info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to rip off, to grind, to cut into small parts

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: avayave = avayavakriyAyAm ityarTaH . ayaM dIpanAyAmapi vartate . dIpanaM prakASanam ityarTaH .

examples: 'piSunaH piMSate vipiMSatIti' (ni0 6.11.1). sa hi svalpamapi pApaM vipiMSati vipuzyatItyarTa iti durgaH.
